article_title: Toward Reliable Connectivity: Measurement-Driven Assessment of Starlink and OneWeb Non-Terrestrial and 5G Terrestrial Networks

public_alternative_audit.lens_oneweb_archive: public OneWeb measurements from Ames, Iowa
public_alternative_audit.reason: The public Starlink and OneWeb installations are not co-located alternatives at one controller, so timestamp overlap would not establish selectable multi-LEO access paths.

claim_gate_reason: No authorized raw synchronized Starlink-OneWeb trace has been received and audited.
allowed_claim: The campaign is an identified candidate for future independent commercial multi-LEO validation.
prohibited_claim: The present work has completed independent longitudinal commercial multi-LEO policy validation, or that time-aligned but spatially separated measurements are selectable paths under one controller.
